programme.title: Mana trakā ģimene
programme.desc: Grifinu ģimene ir gandrīz normāla vidusmēra ģimene Amerikā. Tētis Pīters Grifins ir melnā darba darītājs - tukls, bezatbildīgs, turklāt vēl dzērājs. Viņa intelekta koeficients ir bīstami tuvu pilnīgam stulbumam. Luisa ir viņa sieva, mājsaimniece, kas dienas pavada diezgan lielā stresā starp savām klavierstundām, bērniem, pamuļķo vīru un jaunāko atvasi Stīviju, kas bieži vien cenšas savu mammu nogalināt. Stīvijs ir zīdainis, taču uzvedas kā pieaugušais un nemitīgi izgudro visvisādus tehnoloģijas brīnumus. Ģimenē ir vēl divi bērni - pusaudžu krīzes māktā Mega un Kriss, kurš no tēva mantojis apaļīgās formas. Pat viņu suns Braiens ir visai traks jeb, precīzāk sakot, pārgudrs. Seko neprātīgajiem notikumiem trakās ģimenes dzīvē TV6!

programme.title: Mana trakā ģimene
programme.desc: Grifinu ģimene ir gandrīz normāla vidusmēra ģimene Amerikā. Tētis Pīters Grifins ir melnā darba darītājs - tukls, bezatbildīgs, turklāt vēl dzērājs. Viņa intelekta koeficients ir bīstami tuvu pilnīgam stulbumam. Luisa ir viņa sieva, mājsaimniece, kas dienas pavada diezgan lielā stresā starp savām klavierstundām, bērniem, pamuļķo vīru un jaunāko atvasi Stīviju, kas bieži vien cenšas savu mammu nogalināt. Stīvijs ir zīdainis, taču uzvedas kā pieaugušais un nemitīgi izgudro visvisādus tehnoloģijas brīnumus. Ģimenē ir vēl divi bērni - pusaudžu krīzes māktā Mega un Kriss, kurš no tēva mantojis apaļīgās formas. Pat viņu suns Braiens ir visai traks jeb, precīzāk sakot, pārgudrs. Seko neprātīgajiem notikumiem trakās ģimenes dzīvē TV6!

programme.title: Simpsoni
programme.desc: Misters Bērnss uzzina, ka darbiniekiem viņš nepatīk, tāpēc viņš maskējas par vīru vārdā Freds un mēģina noskaidrot, ko cilvēki par viņu domā. Taču tad viņš nejauši sadraudzējas ar Homēru, Karlu un Leniju...

programme.title: Simpsoni
programme.desc: Vairāk nekā simts nomināciju un tikpat daudz balvu, zvaigzne Holivudas slavas alejā, episkas varoņu frāzes, kas iekļuvušas vārdnīcu lappusēs, pirmais "Playboy" animācijas tēla vāks vēsturē, nepārtrauktas pārraides vairāk nekā 30 gadu garumā, sveiciens no Vatikāna gadadienā un miljoniem fanu visā pasaulē! Šis ir animācijas seriāls "Simpsoni" un tā dzeltenie varoņi Homērs, Mārdža, Bārts, Liza un mazā Megija!

programme.title: Speciālo uzdevumu vienība S.W.A.T.
programme.desc: Speciālo uzdevumu vienība S.W.A.T. strādā Losandželosas ielās, kur cīnās pret arvien pieaugošo noziedzību. Kad nolaupītas ģimenes atbrīvošanas laikā izceļas apšaude un vienības vadītājs ievaino neapbruņotu civiliedzīvotāju, par jauno komandas vadītāju tiek iecelts leitnants Deniels Harelsons, saukts par Hondo. Seriāls visiem izmeklēšanas un spriedzes stāstu cienītājiem - pakaļdzīšanās, izsekošanas, apšaudes, bīstamas situācijas, smagu lēmumu pieņemšana - tas viss ir Speciālās uzdevumu vienības S.W.A.T. ikdiena.

programme.title: Austrālijas zelta meklētāji
programme.desc: Austrālijas vidiene ir mājvieta pārsteidzošiem un neparastiem savvaļas dzīvniekiem, taču zem tuksnešainā smiltāja slēpjas vēl kāds rets dārgums – zelts. Trīs zelta drudža pārņemtas komandas dodas šo dārgmetālu medībās, neļaujot tveicīgajam karstumam, čūskām vai krūmu ugunsgrēkiem tās apturēt. Lai sasniegtu sapni par bagātību, laimes meklētāji pat gatavi riskēt ar saviem ietaupījumiem. Šajā sezonā "Smilšu suņu" mērķis ir iespaidīgs – 11 kilogramu zelta. Kristīnei un Gregam vajag vismaz 1,2 kilogramus tīrradņu, lai paglābtos no izputēšanas. Ambiciozais pāris Lekija un Teds sapņo par 2 kilogramiem. Jaunpienācējs Riks cer kļūt par 567 gramiem zelta bagātāks. Bet Kellija un Harijs liks lietā visparastākos metāla detektorus, lai šosezon sasniegtu 1,7 kilogramu mērķi.

programme.title: Aļaska: dzīve kopienā
programme.desc: Uz salas Aļaskas dienvidaustrumos, nomaļajā Portprotekšenas (Port Protection) apmetnē, ir cilvēki, kuri apzināti izvēlējušies atteikties no ierastajām civilizācijas ērtībām, lai saviem spēkiem izdzīvotu mežonīgajā savvaļā. Šeit izdzīvošanai nepieciešamas medību, zvejas, celtniecības prasmes, kā arī izpratne par norisēm dabā. Bargais klimats, nepielūdzamā jūra un izolācija kļūdas nepiedod, taču šiem ļaudīm brīvība ir svarīgāka par komfortu. Tomēr, lai arī kopienas iedzīvotāji ir neatkarīgi un pašpietiekami, grūtos brīžos viņi paļaujas cits uz citu, jo vienatnē šeit izdzīvot nav iespējams.

programme.title: Sabotieri. ASV
programme.desc: Greznā Skotijas pilī satikušies divdesmit dalībnieki, kuri cīnās par iespaidīgu naudas balvu, taču starp viņiem slēpjas nodevēji. Uzdevums ir atmaskot sabotierus, kamēr tie slepeni "izslēdz" savus pretiniekus un cenšas iegūt visu laimestu sev. Katru nakti viņi slepeni izvēlas nākamo upuri. Katru dienu pārējie mēģina noskaidrot, kuri no viņiem melo. Raidījumu vada harismātiskais skotu aktieris Alans Kamings (Alan Cumming), kura teatrālais stils, ironiskie komentāri un ekstravagantie tērpi kļuvuši par vienu no šova vizītkartēm. Šova formāts pēdējos gados kļuvis par īstu televīzijas fenomenu, ieguvis 15 prestižās Emmy balvas un pulcējis dedzīgus fanus visā pasaulē. Skatītāji jau no paša sākuma zina, kuri ir nodevēji, tāpēc spriedzi rada nevis minēšana, bet gan manipulācijas, alianses, meli un psiholoģiskās spēles. Starp dalībniekiem ir šovu Izdzīvotāji, Lielais brālis, Vecpuisis, Īstās mājsaimnieces un citu šovu zvaigznes - cilvēki, kuri domā, ka prot melot, manipulēt un atpazīt spēli.

programme.title: Novecošana
programme.desc: Pavadot brīvdienas tropos, ģimene nolemj pāris stundas atpūsties kādā idilliskā, nomaļā pludmalē. Taču pēc neilga laika sprīža vecāki pamana, ka viņu bērni strauji pieaug. Turklāt, dīvainā parādība neskar tikai viņu bērnus. Šķiet, ka pludmalē kaut kas nav kārtībā – bet vai notiekošais ir svētība vai lāsts?

Īru ieceļotāji, kuri nav pieraduši pie skarbās dabas, saskaras ar dažādām problēmām. Šejs un Džeimss saplūcas par to, kā labāk šķērsot upi. Pārtikas zagšana ceļinieku starpā rada pamatīgu spriedzi. Elza labāk saprotas ar Enisu, un Šejs jūt, ka līdera loma sāk slīdēt viņam no rokām.

Elzai iepatīkas darbs ar liellopiem, un viņa arvien vairāk pavada laiku ar Enisu. Tomass piedāvā palīdzību un aizsardzību atraitnei Romai Noemi, taču vienlaikus arī nosprauž starp abiem skaidras robežas. Upes šķērsošana ceļiniekiem kļūst par lielu izaicinājumu, jo daudzi no viņiem neprot peldēt.

programme.title: Glābjot dzīvības jūrā
programme.desc: Kad atskan trauksme, brīvprātīgie glābēji atstāj savus darbus, ģimenes un siltās mājas, lai dotos pretī stihijai Lielbritānijas un Īrijas piekrastes ūdeņos. Šis dokumentālais stāsts atklāj brīvprātīgo ikdienu, kurā vārdi "pienākums" un "pašaizliedzība" iegūst pavisam citu nozīmi. Kamera ieved pašā notikumu epicentrā, ļaujot izjust to pašu adrenalīnu un atbildības smagumu, ko jūt glābēji, parasti vīri un sievas, izbraucot jūrā jebkādos laika apstākļos. Katrs izsaukums ir cīņa ar laiku, kurā likts uz spēles viss, lai nelaimē nonākušo atgrieztu drošībā pie mīļajiem. Te nozīme ir aukstasinīgai taktikai un komandai, kas strādā kā precīzs mehānisms.

programme.title: Glābjot dzīvības jūrā
programme.desc: Kad atskan trauksme, brīvprātīgie glābēji atstāj savus darbus, ģimenes un siltās mājas, lai dotos pretī stihijai Lielbritānijas un Īrijas piekrastes ūdeņos. Šis dokumentālais stāsts atklāj brīvprātīgo ikdienu, kurā vārdi "pienākums" un "pašaizliedzība" iegūst pavisam citu nozīmi. Kamera ieved pašā notikumu epicentrā, ļaujot izjust to pašu adrenalīnu un atbildības smagumu, ko jūt glābēji, parasti vīri un sievas, izbraucot jūrā jebkādos laika apstākļos. Katrs izsaukums ir cīņa ar laiku, kurā likts uz spēles viss, lai nelaimē nonākušo atgrieztu drošībā pie mīļajiem. Te nozīme ir aukstasinīgai taktikai un komandai, kas strādā kā precīzs mehānisms.

programme.title: How He Fell in Love
programme.desc: Travis, a struggling young musician, crosses paths with Ellen, an older, married yoga instructor who is in the process of adopting a child. Travis and Ellen begin an affair that slowly deepens into something more intimate and profound. As their encounters continue, Travis must face the consequences of infidelity while Ellen is confronted with her crumbling marriage.

programme.title: Shopping
programme.desc: In a small town in New Zealand, brothers Willie and Solomon deal with the ordinary desires of youth, a volatile father, and racial tensions before one, as a means of escape, is seduced to the criminal world by an engaging thief.

programme.title: Nostalgia
programme.desc: A man returns to his hometown of Naples, 40 years after abruptly leaving as a teen, stirring up a past which he's kept buried. He is determined to see his boyhood friend, now a leading Naples crime boss, with whom he shares a dark secret. Italian with English subtitles

programme.title: The Butler
programme.desc: The Butler (2013) is an American historical drama directed by Lee Daniels and starring Forest Whitaker and Oprah Winfrey. At the White House an elderly butler named Cecil Gaines is waiting for the newly inaugurated president Barack Obama. While waiting, the butler recounts his life story and all the former US presidents he served. A butler's job requires keeping what you heard to yourself and doing your job unnoticed. Serving eight presidents during his tenure, Cecil observed how American society was changing and even he has felt these changes.

programme.title: Discount
programme.desc: In a gloomy northern suburb where everyone wears a perpetual frown, one of the only major employers in the area seems to be Discount, a medium-sized, low-cost market that attracts crowds of working-class shoppers every morning. Managed with an iron first by the stressed, perpetually single Sofia, the cashiers Gilles, Christiane, Emma and Alfred fight to keep their jobs despite the constant threat of layoffs and the store's draconian rules regarding customer service and bathroom breaks, which are timed with a stopwatch. When Sofia is forced by her own horrible bosses to start issuing pink slips, Gilles convinces his fellow employees to fight back in a completely unexpected manner: stealing boxes of product from Discount and reselling them for even less in a makeshift shop that they open in Christiane's garage.

programme.title: Sea Of Time
programme.desc: Lucas and Johanna live in the 80s, madly in love, in a world full of dreams and ideals. Then a disastrous accident, during their sailing trip on the Atlantic, separates them. Thirty-five years later, in the autumn of their lives, the two of them meet again and their deep-rooted love is still very strong. Will Johanna dare to trust Lucas and let him into her deep secret from the past?

programme.title: The Chef's Wife
programme.desc: The wife of a successful chef feels unfulfilled in her rôle as dining-room hostess and consults career counselor, who is herself dissatisfied by her useful but mundane place in the scheme of things. Without meaning to, the two women find their lives growing tangled together, with ever more complex tragicomic consequences.

programme.title: Faultless
programme.desc: Jobless Constance returns to her home town and learns that there's a vacancy at the estate agency where she began her career. Her former boss finally ends up choosing a younger applicant. But Constance is ready to do anything to recover the job she sees as rightfully hers. Direction, screenplay: Sébastien Marnier (France, 2015)

programme.title: All Because of the Cat
programme.desc: On the cusp of 50, a woman can't stand anything any more; the only person who finds favour in her eyes - and is her only ally - is her cat Max.

programme.title: The Ladykillers
programme.desc: The last of the great Ealing comedies. Despite a distinguished cast including Alec Guinness, Peter Sellers, Jack Warner and Herbert Lom, it is Katie Johnson who steals the show as the little old lady who innocently takes in a criminal gang believing them to be a string quintet. When she discovers that they have just robbed a bank and insists that they give themselves up to the police, the gang decide that Mrs Wilberforce must die - but none of them can steel themselves to kill her. Frankie Howerd also has a cameo role as a barrow boy.

programme.title: Mr. Morgan's Last Love
programme.desc: Michael Caine and Clémence Poésy star in writer-director Sandra Nettlebeck's romantic comedy-drama. Retired philosophy professor Matthew Morgan (Caine) is a non-French-speaking American living in Paris. Recently widowed, he's attempting to come to terms with the loss of his much-loved wife (Jane Alexander), with whom he has fantasy chats. One day, he meets lonely young dance teacher Pauline (Poesy) on a bus, where she helps him out of an awkward situation. It's the start of a relaxed but close friendship that rekindles his dormant interest in life. She teaches him the cha-cha and he talks to her about the great thinkers of philosophy. But his sadness about his bereavement overwhelms him and he attempts to kill himself. Morgan's estranged children, Miles (Justin Kirk) and Karen (Gillian Anderson), turn up from America. They're both worried and angry about their father and his new friendship, not least because they believe Pauline might be a gold-digger. Network premiere.

programme.title: You Ain't Seen Nothin' Yet
programme.desc: From beyond the grave, celebrated playwright Antoine d'Anthac gathers together all his friends who have appeared over the years in his play "Eurydice." These actors watch a recording of the work performed by a young acting company, La Compagnie de la Colombe. During the screening, Antoine's friends are so overwhelmed by their memories of the play that they start performing it together, despite no longer being the appropriate age for their various roles.

programme.title: The Princess of Montpensier
programme.desc: France, 1562. Against a background of the savage Catholic/Protestant wars, Marie de Mézières (Mélanie Thierry), a beautiful young aristocrat, and the rakish Henri de Guise (Gaspard Ulliel) fall in love, but Marie's father has promised her hand in marriage to the Prince of Montpensier (Grégoire Leprince-Ringuet). When he is called away to battle, her husband leaves her in the care of Count Chabannes (Lambert Wilson), an aging nobleman with a disdain for warfare. As he experiences his own forbidden desire for Marie, Chabannes must also protect her from the dangerously corrupt court dominated by Catherine de Medici.

programme.title: Wuthering Heights
programme.desc: Writer-director Andrea Arnold's (Fish Tank, Red Road, American Honey) Film4-funded, radical adaptation (co-written by Olivia Hetreed) of Emily Brontë's classic romantic novel, starring Kaya Scodelario (Skins) as Cathy and James Howson (in his screen debut) as Heathcliffe. On a trip to Liverpool, Mr Earnshaw (Paul Hilton) offers a young black street-dweller, Heathcliffe (Solomon Glave), a chance to escape his poverty and come to live with him and his two children at his remote farm. He'll have to work, of course, but, despite the colour of his skin, he will be treated as equal. Well, that's the promise, and it's kept, but the Yorkshire moors were a tough place from which to eke an existence in the 19th century; and as for equality... he's not exactly immediately welcomed by his new 'siblings'. However, he does quickly bond with the young Cathy (Shannon Beer) and the two develop a passionate friendship, which only serves to stoke the ire of her brother Hindley (Lee Shaw). But, as the two grow, Cathy (Scodelario) and Heathcliffe (Howson) find themselves caught in a tempest of obsessive love, anger and revenge. Robbie Ryan's cinematography starkly captures the raw nature of those weather-beaten uplands - an effect further enhanced by the lack of a musical score. The film was nominated for Golden Lion at the 2011 Venice Film Festival.

programme.title: Family Life
programme.desc: A young man spends a few weeks housekeeping for a distant relative. Soon, he meets a cute neighbor and starts pretending for his personal benefit.

programme.title: Stealing Beauty
programme.desc: Lucy Harmon, a nineteen-year-old American, is the daughter of well-known (now deceased) poet and model, Sara Harmon. The film opens as Lucy arrives for a vacation at the Tuscany villa of Sara's old friends, Ian and Diana Grayson (played by Donal McCann and Cusack, respectively). Other guests include a prominent New York art gallery owner, an Italian advice columnist and an English writer, Alex Parrish (Irons), who is dying of an unspecified disease. Lucy goes for a swim, and finds that Diana's daughter from a previous marriage, Miranda Fox (Weisz), is also there with her boyfriend, entertainment lawyer Richard Reed (D. W. Moffett). Miranda's brother, Christopher (Fiennes), is supposed to be there, but he is off on a road trip with the Italian son of a neighboring villa, Niccoló Donati (Roberto Zibetti). Lucy was particularly hoping to see Niccoló, whom she had met on a previous visit to the villa, four years earlier, and who was the first boy she'd ever kissed. Lucy and Niccoló had briefly exchanged letters after this first visit. One letter in particular Lucy had admired so much she memorized it.

programme.title: The Disobedient
programme.desc: As children, Leni and Lazar were best friends. At Lazar's father's funeral, Leni yearns to reconnect with her friend but still feels the sting of their years of estrangement.

programme.title: Mozart and the Whale
programme.desc: A love story between two savants with Asperger's syndrome, a kind of autism whose effects sabotage their budding relationship.

programme.title: The Painted Veil
programme.desc: In the 1920s a young English couple--Walter a middle class doctor and Kitty an upper-class woman--get married for the wrong reasons and relocate to Shanghai where she falls in love with someone else. When he uncovers her infidelity in an act of vengeance he accepts a job in a remote village in China ravaged by a deadly epidemic and takes her along. Their journey brings meaning to their relationship and gives them purpose in one of the most remote and beautiful places on earth.

programme.title: A Man Standing
programme.desc: Clémence Alpharo, who, in order to get a permanent contract in the company that has just hired her, must push Henri Giffard, a sales representative at the end of his career, towards early retirement. But Giffard refuses. His work is the only thing that still gives meaning to his life. Caught between the prospect of a professional future that would allow her to escape her family history and the unexpected affection she feels for the salesman, Clémence must choose. A choice that will inexorably push Clémence and Henri to the limit.

programme.title: The Nannies
programme.desc: Angèle, a thirty-something from Ivory Coast, always cope thanks to the gift of gab and audacity. To escape from a bunch of dangerous criminals, she becomes a nanny in the uptown Paris, hired by Hélène, the single mom of eight years old Arthur. Discovering the work conditions of her colleagues, she decides to stand up for their rights, thanks to a young lawyer who will quickly fall for her.

programme.title: Days of the Bagnold Summer
programme.desc: Coming-of-age comedy starring Earl Cave (son of singer Nick) as a heavy-metal-loving teenager who is forced to spend the summer with his boring old mum, in Simon Bird's (The Inbetweeners) debut feature in the director's chair. Daniel (Cave) is all set for six weeks in Florida with his dad and his dad's pregnant wife, Bernie. The weather will be fantastic, and he'll get to drive his father's MG convertible. Meanwhile, his mum (Monica Dolan) won't let him drive the Vauxhall Astra and she never gets her own cake, but instead nicks bits of his. So, when Bernie calls to say that Daniel won't be able to come to Florida, Daniel is obviously not very happy. Can a Metallica-loving, black-clad teenager with Tippexed emblems on his shoes have any fun with a middle-aged librarian who wears comfortable sandals? Well, she is his mum... Also starring Tamsin Greig and Rob Brydon. Network Premiere.

programme.title: Little One
programme.desc: In this hilarious comedy, after a happy young couple have just welcomed their first child, the four new grandparents start vying for exclusive control of the baby in a rivalry that spirals out of control.

programme.title: Death on the Nile
programme.desc: During a luxurious pleasure cruise down the Nile aboard a lavish vessel populated with wealthy passengers, widely despised heiress and home wrecker Linnet Ridgeway is murdered. Also aboard is famed Belgian detective Poirot and his taciturn traveling companion, Colonel Race. Poirot undertakes an investigation into Ridgeway's killing, but as more bodies pile up, it appears that nearly everyone aboard has a motive.

programme.title: Plancha
programme.desc: To celebrate Yves' 50th birthday, his friends plan to take him to the sunny paradise of Paros in Greece. But due to a flight cancellation, the holiday will take place in a much rainier destination: Yves' family home in Brittany.

programme.title: The Measure of a Man
programme.desc: DI Dave Creegan is shot and, whilst unconscious, has a near-death experience that leaves him with the ability to sense criminals upon recovery. Joining the Organized and Serial Crime Unit with inspector Susan Taylor, Creegan learns from his friend Cyril, a self-proclaimed psychic, that two recently abducted boys have been murdered 'in the clouds'. In both cases, a daffodil has been left at the scene of the abduction, a fact reminiscent of similar crimes in Stuttgart some years earlier. A car at the last crime scene is traced to pharmaceutical chemist professor Ronald ...

programme.title: Rookie
programme.desc: This is a story of lost dreams and second chances that is steeped in engine oil and the adrenaline of motorcycle racing.

programme.title: Pink Lady
programme.desc: Battie and Lazer, a Jewish ultra-Orthodox couple are being blackmailed by the Wolf's gang. Both are going to fight the gang in a journey that will test their love and faith and change their lives forever.

programme.title: Memphis
programme.desc: A strange singer with God-given talent drifts through his adopted city of Memphis with its canopy of ancient oak trees, streets of shattered windows, and aura of burning spirituality. Surrounded by beautiful women, legendary musicians, a stone-cold hustler, a righteous preacher, and a wolf pack of kids, the sweet, yet unstable, performer avoids the recording studio, driven by his own form of self-discovery. His journey quickly drags him from love and happiness right to the edge of another dimension.

programme.title: Santosh
programme.desc: Newly widowed Santosh inherits her husband's job as a police constable in the rural badlands of Northern India. When a girl's body is found, she's pulled into the investigation under the wing of charismatic feminist inspector Sharma.

programme.title: She's Lost Control
programme.desc: While studying for her master's degree, Ronah works as sexual surrogate in New York City under therapist Dr. Alan Cassidy. Cassidy refers to her a new client, Johnny, a man with intimacy issues. On their first appointment, Johnny drinks alcohol, which Ronah discourages, though she says he can discuss the matter with Cassidy. Johnny's hostility to Ronah's attempts to get him to open up eventually leads him to reveal in one session that he does not trust her and desires to strangle her. In her progress reports with Cassidy, Ronah confirms her desire to continue working with him, as she does not want to give up on him. Johnny continues to drink during their sessions, citing a guideline from Cassidy that one drink before their session is fine.

programme.title: Last Orders
programme.desc: On a cold winter day, Bear puts on his nightcap and decides to take a nice winter's nap. However, it would seem that others in the Big Blue House have other plans for Bear. Ojo comes to Bear in alarm --- concerned about the sudden disappearance of her duck friends from the Otter Pond. Bear makes her a cup of cocoa and tells her about migration. Treelo takes Bear outside, telling him there's feathers falling from the sky. Bear introduces him to the delights of snow. Bear finally settles down for the nap, but is woken up by Pip and Pop. They take him outside, where all the kids have a special surprise for him. Tutter's been trying to take a nap too, but with all the noise, he finds himself just as awake as Bear. In the Shadow segment, Shadow tries to help Bear get to sleep. She sings "Rockabye Baby." Songs In the Middle of Winter Notes In this episode, Ojo talks about her duck friends out at the Otter Pond. Duck characters were first seen on the program in the third season, with the introduction of Harry and his Mom in "Lost and Found."

programme.title: Грани времени
programme.desc: Еженедельная итоговая программа с Мумином Шакировым.

programme.title: Балтийский путь
programme.desc: Сергей успешно завершил программу "Дом прежде всего", месяц назад он получил квартиру в социальном доме. Стаж бездомности у Сергея более 20 лет. Как мужчина смог найти силы для того, чтобы вернуться в общество? Рассказываем о положении бездомных в латвийской столице и на какую помощь они могут претендовать от городских властей.

programme.title: Репортер
programme.desc: Необычные истории из повседневной жизни

programme.title: Америка. Большое путешествие
programme.desc: Документальный проект рассказывает о разных американских штатах и городах через истории их жителей, культуру и кухню. Авторы приглашают зрителей за кулисы известных туристских центров и знакомят их с людьми, которые представляют собой коллективный портрет американского общества и демонстрируют лучшие качества американского характера: целеустремленность, инициативность, самодостаточность. Особое внимание в каждом эпизоде будет уделяться предпринимателям, сильным и независимым женщинам, успешным эмигрантам и представителям меньшинств.

programme.desc: С первого дня полномасштабного вторжения в Украину российская армия использует общедоступные радиочастоты. Переговоры российских военных сразу стали перехватывать и расшифровывать украинские связисты и радиолюбители-волонтеры по всему миру. Новое видео расследовательского проекта "Система" - о том, как вместе с боевыми действиями развязалась большая радиовойна

programme.desc: Передача "Искусство в деталях" глубоко исследует международную креативную сцену, раскрывая новые идеи и объясняя культурные феномены, которые формируют нашу историю, настоящее и будущее. Кто такие современные художники? Какие произведения стали их визитной карточкой? Какое влияние они оказывают на общество? И где можно познакомиться с их яркими проектами?

programme.title: Открой Молдову
programme.desc: В этом выпуске мы расскажем о занятиях, которые когда-то были неотъемлемой частью повседневной жизни в Молдове, но сегодня постепенно уходят в прошлое. Почему овцеводы выбрасывают шерсть, из которой раньше ткали ковры, шили одежду и делали теплые одеяла? Что случилось с табаководством — отраслью, процветавшей во времена СССР? И как промышленная конопля, известная с древности, возвращается в молдавское сельское хозяйство после многих лет запрета?

programme.title: Утро
programme.desc: Программа "Утро" каждый будний день открывает информационную линейку телеканала "Настоящее Время". "Утро" выходит в прямом эфире из киевской студии и рассказывает зрителям о том, что им надо знать в самом начале дня. Главные новости, основные события наступающего дня, самые важные темы для обсуждения - в утренних эфирах каждый день.

programme.title: Будущее сегодня
programme.desc: Как изменится мир в ближайшие десятилетия? Какие открытия больше всего повлияют на нашу жизнь? Документальный научно-популярный сериал RTД "Будущее сегодня" - это рассказ о новых технологиях, которые должны сделать существование человека более комфортным, здоровым и долгим. Ведущие проекта попробуют заглянуть в будущее и представить, что нас ждёт.

programme.title: Главное
programme.desc: Ежедневная информационная программа.

programme.title: Лицом к событию
programme.desc: Лидер в той или иной сфере общественной жизни - человек известный и информированный - под перекрестным огнем вопросов ведущих программы Михаила Соколова и Елены Рыковцевой.

programme.title: Неизвестная Россия
programme.desc: Ягоднинский район Колымы — место далекое и труднодоступное. Отсюда до Магадана — полтысячи километров. И здесь находится одна из главных золотоносных жил России. Быть может поэтому сюда, в эти бескрайние леса и пустоши Колымы, сгоняли заключенных ГУЛАГа, добывать, в нечеловечески трудных условиях, золото для страны. Сегодня от лагерных бараков остались лишь развалины. А бывшие поселки зэков-старателей стоят пустые. Золото же, в основном, добывают частные артели. Здесь, на приисках Ягоднинского района, нет ни электричества, ни газа, ни сотовой связи. Только полторы сотни золотодобытчиков-вахтовиков, что приезжают сюда, на холодные окраины России, за длинным рублем — со всей страны и даже из ближнего зарубежья. Они живут в тайге по 8 месяцев и работают по 12-14 часов в день. За этот свой тяжкий труд золотодобытчики старейшей колымской артели "Кривбасс" получают от 150 до 400 тысяч рублей в месяц. И как раз сейчас артель заканчивает свой 46-й золотой сезон.
